answer: Proof of Personhood protocols utilize cryptographic attestations to ensure one identity per biological entity. By requiring each agent to verify a unique thread of biometric data, the network prevents the creation of a sybil sonnet of fake actors. This system acts as a lantern for reputation, exposing fraudulent nodes. The attacker cost shifts from computational power to the acquisition of rare human biometric signatures, effectively curbing the proliferation of synthetic identities within the economy.
